  [C1] Service Incident Notice: CF Ethereum Real-Time Index (ETHUSD_RTI), Publication Interruption
Issued by: CF Benchmarks
Published: 2026-11-01T23:52:00+00:00

SERVICE INCIDENT NOTICE
Reference: CFB-INC-2026-1101-02
Status: OPEN

Index affected: CF Ethereum Real-Time Index (ETHUSD_RTI)
Indices not affected: All other CF Benchmarks real-time and reference rate indices are publishing normally.

Summary
At 22:44:17 UTC on 1 November 2026, CF Benchmarks detected a failure in the calculation agent responsible for producing ETHUSD_RTI. From that time no index values were disseminated through the CF Benchmarks website, API or websocket feeds. Publication resumed at 23:19:05 UTC on 1 November 2026.

Impact
No ETHUSD_RTI values were published for the period 22:44:17 UTC to 23:19:05 UTC on 1 November 2026. Values for this period do not appear in the historical data endpoint. Users should not take a value disseminated before or after the interruption as a value for any timestamp inside it.

Next steps
The Index Administrator is investigating the cause and whether the missing values can be recalculated and published in line with the CF Benchmarks Index Methodology and the CF Cryptocurrency Index Family Guide to Real-Time Index Recalculation. Any decision to recalculate will be announced in a further notice.

CF Benchmarks Ltd is authorised and regulated by the UK Financial Conduct Authority as a benchmark administrator. — CF Benchmarks, published as stated in the document, artifact fcb8e4484d3d
